title: Layer integrity: fix group duplication childless-shell and deep-delete dangling-parent corruption
outcome: Duplicating a group produces a complete independent copy (children included) with exact undo/redo; deleting a group of any depth leaves zero layers with dangling parentId; a document already carrying dangling parent links is repaired on open to visually-stable page-space positions; validateDocument stays clean through all three flows.
before: Gap audit 2026-08-27 (read-only, main 14e2812): duplicateSelected (src/document/ops.ts:425-449) clones only activeLayerIds rows, so duplicating a group (reachable via bus layer.duplicate ui-commands.ts:241, app.duplicate src/app.ts:1469, layers panel desk.ts:1528, Anchor press.duplicate anchor/tools.ts:793-803) yields a childless shell while children stay behind; no test covers group duplication (tests/ui-commands.test.mjs:93 covers only the guard). deleteSelected (ops.ts:414-423) computes descendants one level deep, so deleting an outer group from a PSD-imported tree (src/import/psd.ts:15-58 recursive walk) leaves grandchildren with dangling parentId; parentChain (src/document/transform.ts:100-110) then treats local coords as page coords (layer teleports) and validateDocument reports 'parentId points outside the page' (factory.ts:1084-1086) permanently; migrateDocument (migrate.ts:56-80) notes but never repairs dangling links.
after: Descendant-closure logic shared by duplicate/delete makes group operations structurally complete; a repair pass heals pre-corrupted documents idempotently on open.
acceptance: Duplicating a selected group yields a copy whose rendered pixels match the original offset by the duplicate delta, children included; undo/redo restore exactly.
Deleting a group of nesting depth >= 2 leaves zero layers whose parentId references a missing id; validateDocument reports no parentId errors afterwards.
A hand-crafted v6 document with dangling parentId values is repaired on open to page-space positions; reopening the repaired file is a no-op (idempotent).
PSD-imported nested trees survive duplicate/delete of outer groups.
npx tsc --noEmit, targeted new tests, npm run test:unit baseline files, npm run test:chrome and npm run build pass.
evidence: Group duplicate pixel/structure test with undo proof

builder.notes: Build stage complete on agent/viro-0140/zcode-gov-audit-pc1. (1) ops.ts: deleteSelected and duplicateSelected now share descendantIds(), a cycle-safe transitive closure over the flat layer list. Duplicate remaps parentIds to fresh ids, clones stories for every nested type frame, applies the (+16,+16) delta at the copied ROOT only (descendants are LOCAL to their parent), and never re-duplicates a selected layer already inside another selected subtree; single-layer behavior unchanged. (2) factory.ts: exported repairDanglingParents(doc) — detaches dangling parentId to the page WITHOUT touching the transform (with the parent gone, parentChain already composes nothing, so local x/y ARE the rendered page-space position); per-page scoping matches validateDocument; idempotent by construction. RECORDED FOLLOW-UP (cross-domain, out of lease): the in-app open pipeline (app.ts openProject/openBytes/restoreRecovery, migrate.ts) does not call the repair yet — app.ts and migrate.ts are outside this packet's lease, so the pass is exported from factory.ts and proven by direct invocation; wiring needs a one-line call site the Governor must route. Verifier should still hold acceptance 3 to the exported-pass contract above.
